description: Edits existing values of the profiled app's storage live, compare-and-set (requires enabled Storage write permission): nothing is written unless the current value equals "expected" exactly (same type; floats by bits). prefs: op "update" (key, expected, value of the SAME type) or "remove" (key, expected). db: op "update" one cell (table, column, pk = the row's primary key values in key order, expected, value; primary keys are editable on protocol 12; cut or legacy-redacted cells remain read-only) or "updateRow" (protocol 12: table, pk, edits:[{column,expected,value}], all comparisons and changes in one transaction, including composite primary keys) or "delete" one row (table, pk, rowDigest from read_storage). Codes: ok, conflict (current holds the app's value), already_applied_or_concurrent (it already was the new value: e.g. a retry after a lost answer; nothing written), type_mismatch, read_only:<why> (the schema says why a table is read-only, before you try), unsupported:<why> (e.g. deferred_fk: an edit that could fail at COMMIT on a deferred foreign key; defer_foreign_keys: the app left PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys on, nothing written), invalid_value[:nan_not_storable|nan_payload|lone_surrogate], constraint_failed, not_found, timeout (may still have been applied: read again; never undoable), busy. Prefs report memory (in the app), persisted (true/false/"timeout"; not true = in memory only) and observers "posted_unverified"; a database reports changes and observers "room_invalidation" (Room was told; screens that don't observe the database won't change until they reload). Only an ok final answer carries "undo": call write_storage with exactly that object to revert (it fails as conflict if the app changed the value since, and is refused once the app's link changed: a new session, another app, a restart or reconnect). Pass "target" from the read_storage answer the values came from: the edit is refused (nothing written) when the app's link is another one now. The server never retries. Values are typed: {"t":"string"|"int"|"long"|"integer"|"float"|"real"|"bool"|"stringSet"|"blob"|"null", ...}. Integers are decimal strings (never numbers); float/real carry "bits" (raw IEEE bits, the exact value) and "v" (display only). {"t":"redacted"} values come from older SDK redaction and are not editable; protocol 12 returns original Storage values including credentials. complete:false values were cut: read-only. A prefs entry with "keyLength" has a key too long to send: "key" is only its first code units, read-only (written as a key, that prefix would name ANOTHER key).

edits.description: db updateRow (protocol 12): all fields compared and updated in one transaction, including primary keys

expected.description: The typed value the app must hold now

pk.description: db: the row primary key, typed values in key order

rowDigest.description: db delete: the row digest from read_storage

target.description: The "target" of the read_storage answer the values came from ({serial, packageName, link})

undoOf.description: Only as given in an "undo" object

name: write_storage
title: Edit app storage
